name: qqq
description: Three-phase development harness for Claude Code v2.1.139+. Drives Socratic requirement clarification -> reviewed code plan -> reviewed implementation through 13 phase agents + 14 slash skills. The scripts/qqq CLI + fzf TUI dispatches each phase as a fresh background session (claude --bg) and owns worktree lifecycle directly via git; two plugin-level hooks (qqq-protect-files, qqq-context) provide minimal artifact protection and session-start reminders. Quality assurance is the PR reviewer's responsibility (D1- gate model).
